title: Cold Hearth - stock interior, SOMBER B (SNES register, sparse)
_note: Stock interior cue for rooms where something is wrong - eerie-beautiful, the Hollowing's gentle permanent dark, a hearth gone cold (first use: Hollowfen Stillworks, the derelict null-works of the drained Coldfog Marches). C# minor shot through with whole-tone colour (A-augmented, B-augmented, G-augmented, a D#-F-A cluster before the loop). Only the Vesper motif's rising LEAP survives (G#3-C#4-D#4), and the settle is withheld - the guttering Hollowing treatment from the score bible. pulse25 lead faltering into long rests; a FLUTE glass-harmonica holds long tones in the gaps; a BELL music box runs eighths at the top of each half and WINDS DOWN bar by bar; low two-note STRINGS; sparse tri_bass; a distant clock tick (hat) and mechanical clank (tom); a NOISE breath of air at each phrase end. 66 BPM 4/4, 16 bars.
